resolution: Converted the loop-cut SLIDE drag to the host-owned path. The gizmo drag went host-owned in req_1270, but the loop-cut slide reuses the same TransformGizmo handle while routing through lcDragRef → setLc per move → the [lc] useEffect that re-cuts the entire mesh (lcCutMesh) + setDraft uploads — i.e. the exact per-event React storm the gizmo no longer has, and heavier because re-cutting beats re-translating. User: 'drag is great til i loop cut and then the loop cut drag is ass', and noted it reuses the gizmo. Fix: added lcCutMeshAt(info, offset) to bake the cut at an explicit offset without state, so the slide's onMove streams the cut verts straight to the already-mounted studio.draft dyn slot via patchDynSlot and writes live mesh + readout refs (no setState/move); the final offset syncs to lc ONCE on release (the [lc] effect re-previews at it so the React draft matches the slot, and Apply reads it). The wireframe overlay (liveMeshRef) and DragReadout track the slide off-React like the gizmo. Pure TSX (Studio.tsx), hot-reloadable — patchDynSlot door already shipped in req_1270, no rebuild.
